Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: For the most part, it is a great grille. Takes much longer to build than you would think. Mine arrived with a bent leg (was able to flex it back to shape). The cockpit and grille itself is pretty good quality. Unfortunately the frame and wheels are utterly lacking in durability and quality. At this price point, I would expect the frame and wheels to be superior - and not fall apart within a month. The frame is too flimsy in my opinion. The axle and wheels are a joke. The wheels just pop off at the slightest of uneven ground. The wheels themselves are a cheap plastic readily found on children's toys. That said, it cooks well and holds heat well - just don't plan on moving it.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've had my grill about a month now and it has been great so far. Assembly was easy and my 12 year old son helped me. All of the nuts were already attached to the framing and all I did was align holes and bolt it together. All of the nuts were aligned perfectly. It heats up fast and lights first time. I'm actually surprised by how even the heat is considering there are 3 burners. I'm getting used to the grill and indirect cooking. There seems to be a difference between this grill and my old one. I just have to get used to the indirect cooking on this grill.  The cook box is all aluminum and holds the heat well. There is one vent hole in the back which also helps to hold the heat inside. The tank is easy to access for turning on and off. The spring loaded gauge is nice to see where I am in the life of the tank. Overall I'm very pleased with the grill. Although I haven't tried to clean it yet. That may require another review.

I like being able to get something going with nearly last minute planning and preparation.  It’s also nice for cooking entire meals outside in the summer without warming up the house with the oven while the air conditioner is running. It warms up rapidly for pre-heating and cleaning, the three burners and ample space make it easy to configure for a range of cooking temperatures, direct and indirect.  I’m looking forward to using it year round, as well.  Grilled food nearly every day.  What's not to love about that?!

Results.ReviewText: I like this grill and I have bought Weber grills for many years. I am not crazy about the fact that this new model doesn't have 4 wheels and I also think it is a step down that the area where the grease drips cannot be removed anymore. Don't  misunderstand...there is a grease pan that can be removed/replaced, but it is just the little disposable one as opposed to a large removable pan from the previous model. I think this makes cleaning the grill harder. Having said all of that, the grill is easy to use, a great igniter,  and cooks the food well.
